items.text: the keys sheet is full screen, like the share sheet: the whole page scrolls, the close stays at the top
hints at the top of the screen stay as long as it takes to read them (a long one went in about a second)
the keys sheet is compact again: its keys flow across as many columns as fit, so it shows whole on a laptop and never runs off the top of a large screen
in Auto play, the count of scenes in play sits centered over the In play button
the Founders Club sheet has even margins left and right (it kept room for a scrollbar it never showed)

refresh the pictures, as in Resolume: the ↻ at the top of the Scenes list reloads every picture, and plays each of your scenes that has none for a moment to make one, then goes back to your scene (tap again to stop). New picture, in a scene's ⋯ menu, makes one again

if a scene's picture fails to load once (a moment offline, an update landing), it is tried again soon after and as soon as the connection is back, instead of showing the outline for the rest of the visit
the tools in the shelf under the bar show the moving dots under the ones running (the words playing, a loop, a room), like the row above
certificates carry the duck-rabbit, with your club under it: Founders 100 Club, 500 or 1000, and your founder number. All thirteen paths make it the Current Pathfinders Badge
the founder number is your place among the sign-ups, found with the email you joined with; the credits show it beside your name
